brief: Start on a cliffside overlook with lava below, navigate narrow battlements to a courtyard arena where combat is mandatory, pass through a red skull gate to reach the throne room exit. The path offers no safe retreat after entering the courtyard. Crimson lighting and roaring sounds dominate the atmosphere.
landmarks: crimson stone courtyard with central pillar
red skull gate with glowing eyes
pacing_notes: Build tension through vertical movement and limited retreat options while maintaining oppressive atmosphere.

rubric_hints.navigation: Use vertical drops and narrow passages to guide player flow
rubric_hints.pacing: Create escalating danger by removing safe backtracking after courtyard
rubric_hints.mechanics: Implement red skull as key item for gate access with vertical drop penalties
rubric_hints.affordances: Provide minimal cover in courtyard but clear sightlines for combat
rubric_hints.narrative: Establish the fortress as a living entity through flesh-stone textures and lava integration

seed.theme_hint: Hell keep carved from flesh-stone and lava
seed.structure: cliffside start overlook -> narrow battlements -> courtyard arena -> red skull gate -> throne exit
seed.mechanics: red skull; vertical drops; no safe backtrack after courtyard
